about: Teams (team.md, spec 3.2.0; the main agent and its tree, subagents.md §5–§13, spec 3.4.0 — a member's team_add is now the lead's with `parent`, and `offered` lists 3.4.0's tools): one lead session's team, step by step, written from a reference model of the rules. `start`: the size setting `min` and `max`, `subagents` (enabled for the session; default true) and the chat model's `capacity` (models/schema.json: `parallel`, `single_session`; {} — no limit). The lead is `lead`; its first prompt is running as the case begins, and every agent is on the chat's model, and it is the only model there is (spec 3.3.0: other models are subagents.json's). Steps and what each answers: `offered` (`by` an agent, default lead) — `{tools, setting}`: the team tools listed for that agent, sorted, and whether the setting is shown; `call` (`by`, `tool`, `args`) — `{result, delivered}`: the call's answer word for word (null where an ordinary tool would run: the case looks only at whether it is refused), and what was delivered to whom by this step, `{name: [message, …]}`; `team_read` answers `{room, delivered}` instead, `room` being the messages it shows as `{n, from, to}` (the tree and the text format are loop.json team.read's, checked by each project's own tests); `task` runs a subagent that counts toward the size (and holds a slot) until `task_done` (`by`) — answers null; `finish` (`by`, `reply`, `reason`: stop by default, or steps, budget, `error — <text>`) — the agent's turn ends: a member's reply is its report — `{delivered}`; `set` (`min`, `max`, `capacity`: the person's setting or the model's metadata changed) — null; `person_stop` (`name`) — the person stopped that member in the UI — null; `user` — the person's message to the lead — `{note}`: the note on it (context.md §10), null when there is none; `state` — the team in tree order as `{name, manager, state}`: working, waiting (for a slot), finished, idle (the lead between turns). Delivering to a finished member or the idle lead wakes it (it is then working, or waiting when its model is full). Spec 3.4.0 adds: `start.mode` — the main agent's mode (default edit); `call` to team_whoami, team_finish, team_findings, team_request, team_decide, team_assign, team_replace, answered word for word; `context` (`by`, `used`, `window`) — its engine's context use — null; `context_full` (`by`) — its context reached team.context.pause_at: `{delivered}`; `started` (`by`) — `{text}`: what its latest turn was started with (a brief, or the messages that woke it); `tree` — `{size, open_slots, agents: [{id, name, parent, state, mode, request}], ended: [{id, name, state}]}`; `main_mode` (`mode`) — the main agent's mode changed — null. LLeMbas: services/team.py; CLI: team/.

You may not ask for edit: your request options are execute.
Asked the main agent (r1): you are told its decision. Carry on with what you can meanwhile.

lead:
[Team request r1 from ops to lead:]
bash git push * — to publish the branch

expect.result: Allowed r1 for ops.

ops:
[Team decision on r1 from lead to ops:]
Allowed: bash git push *. Try it again now.

Only to origin.

expect.result: No open request r1.
Asked the main agent (r2): you are told its decision. Carry on with what you can meanwhile.

lead:
[Team request r2 from ops to lead:]
bash rm -rf build — clean

expect.result: Refused r2 for ops.

ops:
[Team decision on r2 from lead to ops:]
Refused: bash rm -rf build.

cases.about: Spec 3.4.0: team_assign gives a subagent new work (it is told, and woken), may move it under another sub-manager, never under its own subtree, and never to one that ended.

expect.result: Added api (owns a part): it is working. Its report comes to you when it finishes. The team is 2 of 6 agents.
Added routes (owns a part): it is working. Its report comes to you when it finishes. The team is 3 of 6 agents.
Added web (owns a part): it is working. Its report comes to you when it finishes. The team is 4 of 6 agents.

lead:
[Team report from web to lead:]
Web done.

expect.result: Assigned to web: it is told now.

web:
[Team assignment from lead to web:]
Now the docs.

expect.result: api cannot go under routes: that is under it.
A subagent's mode cannot be looser than its parent's (edit).
Assigned to web: it is told now.

web:
[Team assignment from lead to web:]
Help with routes.

expect.result: Reported to routes. Your task is done: stop here.

routes:
[Team report from web to routes:]
ok

expect.result: web has ended: replace it (team_replace) or add another.
